builder.name: slotera-release-builder
builder.runtime: Node.js 20+, CPython 3.9+ (PYTHON override, py -3, python3, or python), in-tree deterministic fixed-Huffman DEFLATE writer, and Windows PowerShell 5.1+ or PowerShell 7+ for signed release packaging

release_notes: RC67.4 remediates the RC67.3 release blockers: contact emails no longer expose raw network identifiers, mandatory PHP QA passes with current guards and freeze baselines, Windows checkouts use canonical release line endings, and the signing-key fingerprint is pinned through getslotera.com.
